decisions.reason: The net price display plugin is cheap to maintain and close to the core shop offer, so the firm will likely keep it despite its absence from the website in 2020 to 2021.
The ERP interface took substantial development effort and is central to the announced multichannel integration direction, so the firm will persist with it.
It fits the measurable-marketing positioning and was the flagship of the price comparison line, but its disappearance from the website and overlap with D raise the risk of withdrawal.
It duplicates the other price comparison plugins, a sibling was already withdrawn, and it has not been visible since 2018, so consolidating it frees resources with little loss of face.
The net price reporting plugin complements Product A and the analytics focus, so keeping it remains justifiable even with weak visibility.
